infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ConnectQR uses your camera to scan QR codes so you can instantly share and save contact information.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: ConnectQR saves scanned contacts to your address book so you can reach them later.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ConnectQR does not record audio. This permission is required by the camera module.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: ConnectQR looks for nearby devices on your local Wi-Fi so you can share your contact without Internet.
